before.title: lately／recently 的時態限制
before.content: lately 與 recently 須與現在完成式或現在完成進行式並用。

after.content: lately 用於近期的狀態或重複事件，通常搭配現在完成式或現在完成進行式；recently 也可搭配簡單過去式描述近期發生的一次事件，並非兩者都必須用完成式。

patches.reason: Replace the false mandatory-perfect rule with Cambridge’s explicit usage distinction.

before.title: peculiar
before.content: be peculiar to + 地方 = be native to + 地方 = be indigenous to + 地方。

after.content: be peculiar to + 人／事物／地方：為……所特有。描述物種原生地時可能與 native to／indigenous to 接近，但不能在所有語境一概互換。

patches.reason: Restrict the native/indigenous equivalence to relevant contexts; peculiar-to can describe non-origin properties.

before.title: to one’s fury
before.content: *n.* 震怒。to one’s fury；形容詞 furious；近義 anger / rage。

after.content: to one’s fury：使某人盛怒的是；fury 為名詞，形容詞為 furious。

patches.reason: Give the actual to-one’s-fury phrase meaning rather than only the isolated anger noun.

before.title: anger / rage
before.content: *n.* 震怒。to one’s fury；形容詞 furious；近義 anger / rage。

after.content: anger／rage：憤怒／盛怒，與 fury 為近義詞。

patches.reason: Align the content with its existing anger/rage title without duplicating the unrelated phrase explanation.

before.title: no later than + 時間
before.content: 在某個時間點之前。例：The article must be submitted no later than May 31st.（這篇文章得在 5 月 31 日前遞交。）

after.content: 不晚於某個時間點，包含該時間點。例：The article must be submitted no later than May 31st.（這篇文章最遲須於 5 月 31 日遞交。）

patches.reason: Clarify the inclusive no-later-than boundary and synchronize this exact repeated example.
